name: Notification drop
summary: A phone-style notification (app icon, title, time, one-line body) that springs down from the top and flies back up on exit. Good for reactions, group chats, alerts, and social proof moments.

params.title: string
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as notif from '../blocks/notification-drop/index.mjs';
const ping = notif.create(ctx, { title: 'New message', body: 'wait, how did you do that??', cues: { in: CUE.chat, out: CUE.logo - 0.2 } });
changelog: v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
